page.title: 名詞のかたちは、中心へ重ねる

analysis.summaryJa: 英語の名詞句は、中心となる名詞へ情報を外側から順に重ねて作る。基本の並びは、the・this・ourなどの限定詞、数や量を表す語、性質を表す形容詞、最後に中心名詞である。たとえばthe three new printersではprintersが中心で、newが性質、threeが個数、theがどの集合かを示す。形容詞自体は複数形にならず、可算性と単複は中心名詞に表れる。不可算名詞でもsome useful informationのように同じ順序で重ねられる。語を日本語順に並べず、最後の名詞を先に見つけて左側の層を整理することが重要である。
grammarPoints: 名詞句の基本語順は限定詞＋数・量＋形容詞＋中心名詞
中心名詞が可算単数ならa/anなどが必要で、複数なら中心名詞に複数形を付ける
形容詞は単数・複数で形を変えず、中心名詞の前に置く
the・this・those・ourなどの限定詞は名詞句の最も外側に置く
数詞・several・many・someなどは形容詞より前に置く
不可算名詞もsome useful informationのように、量＋形容詞＋中心名詞の順で組み立てる
序数と基数が並ぶ場合はthe first two sessionsのように序数を先に置く
visualEvidence: 限定詞・数・形容詞・中心名詞がレール上で順に連結する構図
some＋beautiful＋musicで不可算名詞にも同じ層構造が働く
中心名詞が最後に置かれ、前の語がその範囲を狭める矢印
a three blue carsを誤りとして直すミニ確認
commonTraps: 形容詞と数詞を逆にしてred three boxesのようにする
限定詞を数詞の後ろへ置き、three the boxesのようにする
形容詞に複数-sを付け、news printersのようにする
不可算名詞を中心に置くとき複数-sやa/anを付ける
a/anを中心名詞だけで判断し、直後の形容詞の音を見落とす
this two filesのように単数指示詞と複数中心名詞を組み合わせる

questions.prompt: The IT team installed ------- in the customer-service area yesterday.

choices.A: new three printer
choices.C: three new printers

questions.translationJa: ITチームは昨日、顧客サービス区域に新しいプリンターを3台設置しました。
questions.explanationJa: 数詞threeは形容詞newより前に置き、中心名詞printersを複数形にします。

questions.prompt: The guide provided ------- about local transportation options.

choices.A: some useful information
choices.C: an useful information

questions.translationJa: 案内係は地域の交通手段について役立つ情報を提供しました。
questions.explanationJa: 不可算名詞informationにはsomeを使い、形容詞usefulは中心名詞の直前に置きます。

questions.prompt: We received ------- from the supplier just before the office closed.

choices.A: a request urgent
choices.C: an urgently requests

questions.explanationJa: 可算単数requestを形容詞urgentが修飾し、母音音の前なのでanを使います。

questions.explanationJa: 複数指示詞those、数詞two、形容詞large、複数名詞boxesの順です。

questions.prompt: The director will visit ------- during her trip to Singapore.

choices.C: our regional new offices

questions.explanationJa: 所有限定詞ourを最初に置き、その後に形容詞new、中心名詞officeが続きます。
questions.focus: 所有限定詞＋形容詞＋名詞

questions.explanationJa: 限定詞the、数詞five、形容詞remaining、複数名詞seatsの順です。

questions.prompt: The finance department prepared ------- for the board meeting.

choices.C: detailed a finance report

questions.focus: 限定詞＋複数形容詞＋名詞

questions.focus: 数量語＋形容詞＋複数名詞

questions.prompt: All employees must read ------- before entering the laboratory.

choices.D: Unusually an large shipment arrived this morning.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about an unspecified amount of information.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about a large number of pleased customers.

choices.B: Many satisfieds customers renewed their memberships.
choices.C: Many satisfied customers renewed their memberships.
choices.D: Much satisfied customers renewed their memberships.

questions.translationJa: 満足した多くの顧客が会員資格を更新しました。

choices.C: First the two trainings sessions will be held online.
choices.D: The first two training session will be held online.

questions.translationJa: 最初の2回の研修はオンラインで実施されます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about every application that is complete.

choices.A: Completed each applications receive a reference number.
choices.B: Each complete applications receives a reference number.
choices.C: Each completed application receives a reference number.
choices.D: Each completed application receive a reference number.

choices.B: The agenda includes a short scheduled break after lunch.
choices.C: The agenda includes a scheduled short breaks after lunch.
choices.D: The agenda includes an short scheduled break after lunch.

questions.explanationJa: a＋short＋scheduled＋breakの順で、可算単数breakを限定します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The four damaged packages were returned."

choices.B: Four specific packages that had been damaged were sent back.
choices.C: One package contained four undamaged items.
choices.D: An unspecified amount of packaging was returned.

questions.translationJa: 破損した特定の荷物4個が返送されました。
questions.explanationJa: the＋four＋damaged＋packagesは、特定集合の個数と状態を順に示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "We received some confidential information."

choices.A: We received one confidential information item with an article.
choices.B: We received several informations that are public.
choices.C: We received no information from anyone.
choices.D: We received an unspecified amount of information that must be kept private.

questions.translationJa: 秘密にすべき情報を量を特定せず受け取りました。
questions.explanationJa: some confidential informationは不可算名詞の未特定量を表します。
questions.focus: some＋形容詞＋不可算名詞の意味

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "An experienced interpreter joined the meeting."

choices.A: Several inexperienced interpreters left the meeting.
choices.C: One interpreter with substantial experience joined the meeting.
choices.D: The already identified interpreter joined every meeting.

questions.translationJa: 経験豊富な通訳者1人が会議に参加しました。
questions.explanationJa: an experienced interpreterは未特定の一人とその性質を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "Our two largest conference rooms are reserved."

choices.A: The two biggest conference rooms belonging to us have been booked.
choices.B: Two conferences are being held in someone else's smallest room.
choices.C: All rooms everywhere are available.
choices.D: One large room has no reservation.

questions.translationJa: 当社の最も大きな会議室2室は予約済みです。

choices.D: The reviewer provided more than a few helpful suggestions.

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The last available seat was sold."

choices.C: The first unavailable flight was canceled.
choices.D: All seating material was given away.

questions.explanationJa: the＋last＋available＋seatで特定・順序・状態を示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "Many new customers used the mobile app."

choices.B: One existing customer deleted every app.

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The team submitted a carefully prepared proposal."

choices.D: The team submitted one proposal that had been prepared with care.

choices.A: Three the damaged chair
